import importlib.util
import sys
from datetime import timedelta

spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("m", "sdks/python/hatchet_sdk/utils/timedelta_to_expression.py")
m = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(m)

for td, want in [(timedelta(hours=2), "2h"), (timedelta(minutes=3), "3m"), (timedelta(seconds=3661), "3661s"), (timedelta(hours=96, seconds=1), "345601s")]:
    got = m.timedelta_to_expr(td)
    if got != want:
        sys.exit(f"timedelta_to_expr({td!r}) = {got!r}, want {want!r}")

for td in [timedelta(milliseconds=1500), timedelta(microseconds=1), timedelta(seconds=-5), timedelta(hours=-1)]:
    try:
        got = m.timedelta_to_expr(td)
    except ValueError:
        continue
    sys.exit(f"timedelta_to_expr({td!r}) = {got!r}, want ValueError")
EOF

import importlib.util
import sys

m = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
